pli-tv-bu-vb-sk36:1.2: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū sūpaṃ pi byañjanaṃ pi odanena paṭicchādenti bhiyyokamyataṃ upādāya --pe--.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk36:1.3.1: na sūpaṃ vā byañjanaṃ vā odanena paṭicchādessāmi bhiyyokamyataṃ upādāyā 'ti sikkhā karaṇīyā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk36:1.4: na sūpaṃ vā byañjanaṃ vā odanena paṭicchādetabbaṃ bhiyyokamyataṃ upādāya.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk36:1.5: yo anādariyaṃ paṭicca sūpaṃ vā byañjanaṃ vā odanena paṭicchādeti bhiyyokamyataṃ upādāya, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
